notes.title: Discover Gemcraft's Hidden Cat Bundle & Cat Awareness 2024! 🐾 Kittynawa Update!
notes.content:
Hello, cat lovers and cozy gamers!

We have some exciting news to share with you today:


🌟 Only 5 days left for Cat Awareness 2024!
As part of this special event, we’re joining other amazing developers to celebrate all things feline. Don’t miss out on the chance to explore a wide range of cat-themed games from various devs, including our own! It's the perfect time to discover new favorites.

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/CatAwarenessFelineSale][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759927/1554f4fed5def6e87152ef539ef79b1a8bf10e7f.png[/img][/url][/b]
[center][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/CatAwarenessFelineSale]Click the image to explore Cat Awareness 2024![/url][/b][/center]


🐾 Gemcraft's Hidden Cat Bundle is here!
We’re thrilled to announce our new bundle, featuring Purrfectly Hidden Cats - Kittenwood, Purrfectly Hidden Cats - Kittenbay, and our latest release, Hidden Cat Memories—all at a 15% discount! Whether you’re a seasoned cat-finder or new to the genre, this bundle offers a delightful experience for all.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43994/Gemcrafts_Hidden_Cat_Bundle/

🎮 Kittynawa Update: September Launch
Lastly, we’re excited to share that Kittynawa is on track for a September release. We’ve been hard at work bringing this project to life, and we can’t wait for you to explore this enchanting world full of hidden secrets and mystical cats. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2841060/Pawsome_Hidden_Cats__Kittynawa/

Thank you for your continued support! We hope you enjoy the bundle, participate in Cat Awareness 2024, and stay tuned for more updates on Kittynawa.

Happy gaming, and may your cat-finding adventures be purrfect! 🐾

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 - Social Chatter Achievement fix.
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

This is a small patch aimed at improving the triggering mechanism for Achievements, specifically to address the persistent issue where the Social Chatter Achievement (click all humans) fails to activate to some players. We hope this update will completely eradicate the problem. While the fix has worked for us, we recommend that those who have encountered this issue perform a full reset from within the game after applying the update.

Thank you, and we apologize for any inconvenience caused by this bug.

Gemcraft Games Team
